steps.en: A confirmation prompt appears before anything is saved
steps.id: Prompt konfirmasi muncul sebelum data disimpan

steps.en: Officer is warned that old particulars will be overwritten
steps.id: Officer diperingatkan bahwa data lama akan ditimpa
steps.why_en: On the single path the warning comes before typing, not at the final confirm.
steps.why_id: Di jalur satu notice peringatan muncul sebelum mengisi, bukan di konfirmasi akhir.

steps.en: Old data is replaced only after the officer agrees
steps.id: Data lama diganti hanya setelah officer setuju
